title: Electronic skin instantly displays touch as light
summary: Researchers developed a flexible electronic skin that lights up upon touch to visualize pressure location and intensity.

title: Cadence launches AI model portfolio for engineering workflows
summary: The Maestro portfolio provides improved results and token efficiency with secure cloud and on-premises options.

title: Proposed Welsh rail testing facility seeks £330M private capital
summary: A planned Welsh rail testing facility is still searching for £330M in private capital to advance construction.

title: Cadence announces Maestro AI Model Portfolio
summary: Cadence introduced the Maestro AI Model Portfolio to power AI Super Agents across semiconductor and system design workflows.

title: Anglia signs franchise agreement with Novosense
summary: Anglia Components signed a Pan-European franchise agreement with analog and mixed-signal IC manufacturer Novosense Microelectronics.

title: Biological Computer 'Hive Mind' Combines Human Neurons
summary: Researchers found that combining 15 synthetic biological computer brains allows their collective human neurons to work together and outperform AI.

title: Split Mass Residence Features Sloping Rooftop Garden
summary: K-Thengono Design Studio completed an Indonesian home featuring a green roof, a rooftop swimming pool, and an open interior layout.

title: OMRON to Acquire OnLogic for Edge AI
summary: OMRON is acquiring OnLogic to combine industrial computing with its automation expertise for AI-intensive applications.

title: Flexell Space Establishes French Subsidiary
summary: Flexell Space created a new French subsidiary to support ongoing contract and volume-production discussions with European customers.

title: Australia's Snowy 2.0 Pumped Storage Project Faces Cost Increase
summary: Snowy Hydro reported that the Snowy 2.0 pumped storage project could cost up to A$25 billion with completion delayed to 2029.

title: NASA Ends Swift Space Telescope Mission
summary: NASA officially ended the Swift Observatory mission after a private satellite failed to dock with the spacecraft in orbit.

title: Learning Force-Reactive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Researchers introduce FLORE, a framework using a force-reactive diffusion policy and compliance controller to achieve force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation.

title: Nonprehensile Robotic Catching Using Virtual Constraints
summary: A new approach uses virtual nonholonomic constraints to solve nonprehensile robotic catching without requiring object trajectory prediction.

title: Bodyseismography for Contactless Cardiac Assessment
summary: A source-transmission-measurement framework models cardiovascular vibrations and body-bed mechanics to enable contactless assessment of cardiac mechanics.

title: Information-Theoretic Secure Aggregation with Heterogeneous Quantization
summary: A new federated learning secure aggregation scheme tolerates client dropouts and collusion under heterogeneous client quantization levels.

title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench
summary: An evaluation of a multimodal large language model agent controlling a robot demonstrates its capabilities and limitations across manipulation tasks.

title: Security Region Compression via Hybrid Vertex Pruning
summary: A vertex pruning approach using local and backward search policies compresses power system security regions to enhance computational efficiency.

title: World Model for Energy Efficiency in Dynamic Metasurface Antennas
summary: A world model framework optimizes digital beamforming and dynamic metasurface antenna element weights to maximize time-averaged energy efficiency.

title: Focusing Efficiency for Large Intelligent Surfaces
summary: Researchers derive the optimal current distribution on large intelligent surfaces to characterize maximum achievable wireless power transmission efficiency.

title: Graph Neural Network for Wide-Area Ambisonic Rendering
summary: A lightweight graph neural network refines spatial interpolation to enable wide-area 6DoF Ambisonic rendering from sparse recordings.

title: Routed Ensembles Improve Multi-Objective RL
summary: Researchers introduce routed ensemble policy learning and kernel surrogate attribution to improve multi-objective reinforcement learning performance and efficiency.

title: Specola Tool for Specification-Driven Robot Evaluation
summary: Specola is a new Python tool and benchmark interface that evaluates robot behaviors in simulation using Signal Temporal Logic specifications.

title: Dual-Measurement Frequency-Droop for Meshed DC Networks
summary: A new dual-measurement frequency-droop controller enables stable grid-forming operation for AC/DC converters in meshed MVDC networks.

title: TrySee Pipeline for Closed-Loop Robot Task Planning
summary: TrySee integrates general VLM reasoning with domain-specific modular perception for closed-loop robot task planning without requiring fine-tuning.

title: FISRF Framework Improves Robot Task Planning Efficiency
summary: The Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework uses an agent-mentor architecture to reduce error-correction rounds and improve robot task success rates.

title: Continuous-Time Safe Planning for Agile Quadrupeds
summary: A new real-time motion planning framework maintains fully-actuated SE(2) models and uses composite Bernstein polynomials to certify collision avoidance for quadrupeds.

title: Environment Edits as Corrective Signal for Reward Learning
summary: The FERRET algorithm learns robot and object preferences by leveraging human environment edits as a complementary corrective feedback signal.

title: VPR-Space Benchmark for Extraterrestrial Visual Place Recognition
summary: VPR-Space is a new benchmark featuring sixteen datasets to evaluate visual place recognition algorithms in space analog environments.

title: TRIDENT Waveform Detector for Dolphin Vocalizations
summary: TRIDENT is a new waveform-based detector designed to identify broadband dolphin transient vocalizations amidst noisy impulsive ambient shrimp sounds.

title: FedAvgIm Federated Learning for Inverter-Based Resources
summary: FedAvgIm is a privacy-aware federated learning framework that performs multi-site impedance identification of inverter-based resources under data scarcity.
